user_message.optional_appended_input: [evaluation_rationales] with content/organization/expression; never a target or reference score

score_prediction.generative_output: three score+rationale objects exactly as declared in evaluation.txt
score_prediction.encoder_output: three score heads only; rationale may be input in the rationale arm

rationale_generation.output: requested rationale fields only; no score emitted
rationale_generation.score_semantics: predicted_score is a condition supplied by the separate score model, not a label emitted by the rationale model

rationale_judge_reward.system_message: entire source file exactly; file has no separate user marker and ends by requesting the following information
rationale_judge_reward.output: 12 integer judge cells: 3 axes x 4 rationale-quality dimensions

cross_role_rule: Score prediction, score-conditioned rationale generation, and rationale judging are separate message contracts and must never reuse one another's output schema.
